ModMetaData.name: Pawn Idle Diagnostics 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Read-only diagnostics for player pawns that enter idle/wander jobs. Records ThinkTree/job source, recent JobGiver_Work result, work priorities, allowed-area state, needs/capacities, Harmony patch owners, and a rate-limited WorkGiver candidate scan. Does not alter AI decisions or issue jobs.
